notes: Ten localized movable-part episodes are reported. The two leaves of the double upper cabinet are listed separately because they are distinct movable parts, although both appear to be manipulated within the same short sampled intervals, so their individual timing is lower confidence.
scene_description: A person surveys a studio apartment and sequentially opens and closes an entry closet, microwave, oven, dishwasher, a two-door upper cabinet, a lower drawer, the refrigerator and freezer compartments, and a laundry closet.
